description: This file is a React functional component that manages a credentials panel, allowing users to view, add, update, and delete AI provider credentials. It utilizes various hooks, components, and external API calls to handle credential data and user interactions.

methods.name: handleUpdateCredential
methods.description: Handles the updating of a credential by transforming form values and calling the API, then refetching credentials and showing notifications.

methods.name: handleAddCredential
methods.description: Handles adding a new credential by transforming form values, calling the API, and refreshing the credential list.

methods.name: renderProviderBadge
methods.description: Returns a badge component with color coding based on the credential provider name.

methods.name: handleDeleteCredential
methods.description: Deletes a selected credential via API call, refetches data, and manages UI state and notifications.

methods.name: openDeleteModal
methods.description: Opens the confirmation modal for deleting a specific credential.

methods.name: closeDeleteModal
methods.description: Closes the delete confirmation modal, clearing the selected credential.
